verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

The workflow now derives the protected manifest and its retirement approvals from one resolvable commit contained in the graded merge tree, so a lagging merge ref no longer compares that tree against later base-tip enrollments. The fail-closed empty/unresolvable guard remains intact, and entries enrolled at the selected baseline remain protected. The accompanying YAML-object pin is independently typed, rejects ambiguous/missing named steps, includes step-level keys, and has faithful plus non-crashing mutant fixtures; the real-history checks separately demonstrate the false-refusal case, genuine unapproved removal, and approved removal. The later PR-head merge-base materialization is included in the frozen region consistently. The research-only addition explicitly records unresolved platform facts and makes no behavioral authorization by itself. I found no blocker or major correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security defect in the diff.
